study type: secondary analysis of a random sampling
exposure: maternal body mass index before pregnancy
cohort: 15,194 deliveries in 15 hospitals in Beijing, China, from June 2013 to November 2013
finding: Maternal body mass index before pregnancy, gestational weight gain, gestational diabetes and pre-gestational diabetes, and third trimester cholesterol levels were risk factors for both hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and severe PE, while first trimester high-density lipoprotein was a protective factor for severe PE.
